info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Property Portfolio Retrieval API
info.description: The Property Portfolio Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about property portfolios within the banking facilities. This API serves as a vital tool for financial analysts and real estate professionals seeking insights into property performance and investment opportunities. By utilizing specific parameters, users can retrieve comprehensive data regarding various properties, including valuations, occupancy rates, and owner information. This functionality supports informed decision-making and strategic planning for stakeholders in the banking and real estate sectors.

get.description: Fetch detailed information about a specific property portfolio identified by its unique ID. This endpoint allows users to access various attributes related to the portfolio, including its properties, financial information, and management details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about a specific property portfolio identified by RES-100045. It should include any necessary parameters for the operation to successfully return the desired data.
